originalTitle: Mcap of nine of top-10 most valued firms erodes by Rs 2.74 lakh cr; HDFC Bank takes biggest hit
simplifiedContent: Last week was a tough time for the Indian stock market, with 9 out of the top 10 biggest companies losing value. This meant that the total value of these companies decreased by Rs 2.74 lakh crore. HDFC Bank was the biggest loser, with its value dropping by over Rs 1 lakh crore. Reliance Industries also lost a significant amount of value, but Hindustan Unilever was the only one of the top companies to actually gain value. This matters because it shows that the market is experiencing a downturn, which can be concerning for investors who own stocks in these companies.

originalTitle: IPO rush: 9 companies  to launch issues on D-St this week, raising over Rs 11,000 cr
simplifiedContent: This week, 9 companies are going to sell their shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). These companies are trying to raise over 11,000 crore rupees in total. The biggest IPO is from Manipal Health Enterprises, which wants to raise around 9,275 crore rupees. This is a big deal because it shows that many companies are interested in raising money from the stock market, and it could be a good opportunity for investors to buy shares in these companies. It's a busy week for the stock market, with many IPOs happening at the same time.

originalTitle: IPO Buzz: Over a dozen firms, including Zepto set for debut next month
simplifiedContent: Next month, many companies, including Zepto, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO). More than a dozen companies are expected to do this, and together they hope to raise over 25,000 crore rupees. This is a significant amount of money and shows that the stock market is active and growing. Companies like Zepto and Shiprocket are leading the way, and investors are becoming more confident and excited about new companies listing on the market. This surge in IPO activity is creating a lot of excitement in the stock market.

originalTitle: Q1 results 2026: BEL to Adani Enterprises among companies to declare Q1 results next week; check full list here
simplifiedContent: Next week, several big companies will announce their financial results for the first quarter of 2026. This means they will share how well they did financially from January to March 2026. Some of the well-known companies that will be sharing their results include Bharat Electronics, Adani Enterprises, and Hindustan Unilever, among others. This is important because it will give investors an idea of how these companies are performing, which can help them decide whether to invest or not. By looking at these results, investors can get a sense of which companies are doing well and which ones might be struggling.

originalTitle: Indian stock market: How are Sensex and Nifty 50 likely to perform next week amid ongoing US-Iran war?
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a bad week, with two important measures, the Sensex and Nifty 50, falling in value. The Sensex dropped by 2.68% to 76,059.77, and the Nifty 50 fell by 2.33% to 23,767.45. This means that people who invested in the stock market likely lost some money. The reason for this drop is related to the ongoing conflict between the US and Iran, which is affecting stock markets around the world. The performance of the Sensex and Nifty 50 will be closely watched next week to see how they will be impacted by this situation.
